column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE IMMIGRANTS AND EMIGRANTS ACT
(CHAPTER 351)

column1: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :–

column2: This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Immigrants  and
Section  14  of  the  Immigrants  and  Emigrants  Act
in subsection (1) thereof, by the substitution for the
words, “two years,” of the words “five years,”;
in subsection (2) thereof, by the substitution for the
words, “exceeding two years but not exceeding five
years,”  of  the  words  “exceeding  five  years  but  not
exceeding ten years,”; and
by  the  insertion  immediately  after  subsection  (3)
thereof, of the following subsection:-

(a) Notwithstanding  the  time  limits
“(3A)
specified  in  subsections  (1)  and  (2),  the  period  of
permanent residence visa may be determined by the
Minister.
(b) For the purpose of paragraph (a), “permanent
residence  visa”  means,  a  visa  granted  under
regulations made under this Act.”.
In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala

column1: and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
